breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt contained a confusing preamble with contradictory definitions for the spatial grid (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1) vs dx=(b-a)/Nx for a periodic domain). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble and extracted the specific, correct instruction from the 'Numerical method requirements' section, stating to use a 'uniform periodic grid with Nx=512 points on [0,1) ... with dx=1/Nx'. This aligns with the ground truth, which resolves the issue by removing the contradictory text from the preamble.
